# Apply Progress: #456 slice A — the SDD stage set becomes data

**Worktree**: /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-456 (branch feat/issue-456-..., off origin/main @ b6f9dd8)
**Batch**: 1 (first and only batch this session) — no previous apply-progress existed.
**Mode**: Strict TDD (npm test, node:test). Baseline 4497 pass/0 fail -> Final 4519 pass/0 fail (+22 tests, 0 regressions).
**No commit/push/PR performed** per instructions — worktree left with uncommitted changes for human review.

## Completed Tasks
- [x] Phase 1 (1.1-1.6): sdd-layout.mjs — added LIFECYCLE_STAGES (frozen four), resolveStageSet(config) pure function with 3 refusals (omission, relative-order per D5a, file-collision), artefactFiles(names, fileMap=ARTEFACT_FILE) gained optional fileMap param. REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS re-derived as artefactFiles(LIFECYCLE_STAGES), stays export const (cites-resolve.test.mjs symbol probe still passes).
- [x] Phase 2 (2.1-2.2): stage-engine.mjs — SDD_LIFECYCLE_STAGES collapsed to `= LIFECYCLE_STAGES` re-export. stage-engine.test.mjs verified UNMODIFIED (git diff --stat empty) — ADR-0019 Amendment 1 condition 4 preserved.
- [x] Phase 3 (3.1-3.2): phase-order-check.mjs — STANDARD_ARTEFACTS local literal replaced by LIFECYCLE_STAGES import (one-line default-param swap on pre-existing seam per D7). Pinned 'spec.md/design.md' literal still selected, 42/42 green.
- [ ] Phase 4 (4.1-4.3): Migration 0.11.0 — NOT APPLIED. config-migrations.mjs is brain/core/**, Tier 3, prohibited by repo doctrine (AGENTS.md). Drafted instead at openspec/changes/issue-456-stage-set/brain-drafts/config-migrations-0.11.0.md with exact migration entry + companion test edits for brain-config.test.mjs and stage-engine.test.mjs (both reference the real migrations array — applying just the test half would go RED against nothing real). Design planned Phases 1-3/5-6 to stay green without this landing, confirmed true.
- [x] Phase 5 (5.1-5.3): second drift-guard scan — scanForRivalStageArray added to sdd-layout.test.mjs, bare-name notation (vs A1's .md-suffixed scan), same BRACKET_RE window + 3-of-4 quoted-token threshold, one allowlist entry (governance-tiers.mjs TIER_PARAMS, reason states REQ-L4-2'). Landed LAST after Phases 2-3 removed both bare-name literals; real-tree scan returns zero.
- [x] Phase 6 (6.1-6.3): REQ-L4-2' both directions asserted at lite (SCAFFOLD four vs GATE ['spec.md']); assertRoutableStage proven to still refuse all four even when sdd.stages declares them + a custom stage; six set-blind importers (session-start.mjs, memory/backends/engram.mjs, memory/lib/feature-resolution.mjs, lib/archive-sweep.mjs, lib/archive-logic.mjs, new-change.mjs) confirmed unedited via git status --porcelain.
- [x] Phase 7 (7.1-7.2): two Tier 3 draft corrections created under brain-drafts/ (ADR-0019 Amendment 1 citation fix — "Twelve modules" -> ten production/eighteen with tests, ARTEFACT_FILE 4->5 entries, line-number->symbol citations; sdd-layout.md guard-scope correction — guard now covers both notations). Final verify run: npm test 4519/0, npm run repo:check pass, npm run brain:nav pass.

## Files changed
- brain/scripts/lib/sdd-layout.mjs (+131/-4) — resolver + refusals
- brain/scripts/lib/stage-engine.mjs (+18/-1) — re-export collapse
- brain/scripts/vcs/phase-order-check.mjs (+11/-2) — default swap
- brain/scripts/lib/sdd-layout.test.mjs (+301, excluded from diff budget by governance.ignoreList **/*.test.mjs) — 22 new tests
- openspec/changes/issue-456-stage-set/{tasks.md updated with [x], apply-progress.md created, brain-drafts/*.md x3 created}

Countable production diff: 167 lines, well under lite tier's 1000-line budget (and under standard's 400).

## Deviations / gaps noted in report (not silently resolved)
- D5's file-collision refusal has no explicit Scenario in spec.md (design-only) — implemented per design prose, flagged for spec.md follow-up amendment.
- spec.md's scenario prose writes sdd.stages as a bare array; design D3/§5 is unambiguous it's an OBJECT keyed by stage name (Record<string,{artefact?:string}>), migration default {} not []. Implemented per design (object form) — spec's array notation read as shorthand, not literal shape. Flagged so a future spec.md-only reader isn't misled.

## Pre-existing, unrelated change in worktree
openspec/config.yaml (strict_tdd false->true, testing baseline block) was ALREADY modified before this apply batch started (visible in git status at session start) — not made by this apply run, not part of issue-456 slice A scope, left untouched.

## Status
7/7 phases addressed (6 applied+verified, 1 drafted per Tier 3 constraint). Ready for sdd-verify.
